patterns.desktop: The page runs loud to quiet in bands. Collage fills one side of a section or a bounded band and never sits behind reading text, prices, tables, or forms.
patterns.mobile: Headline, facts, and CTAs come first with the portrait hero collage below; stage cards stack with a 3:2 image above text; expressive art is restacked rather than hidden.
patterns.conversion: Explore tickets is visible at first paint beside the facts card and repeated in the ticket teaser and CTA band.

patterns.purpose: Explore every act by day and stage; names never depend on hover or animation.

patterns.desktop: A consistent card grid holds 4:5 artwork, visible names, badges, and start times; tilt appears only on hover or focus.
patterns.mobile: Cards stack one or two across; the list view is the stable fallback and may be the default on narrow screens.
patterns.conversion: Each card links to its set details with the day, stage, and start time already visible.
